# Aplaus

> Monorepo: unofficial Librus Synergia client — Hono API on Cloudflare Workers (KV only) + PWA.

## Packages

- [librus-client](packages/librus-client/AGENTS.md): deep module wrapping the unofficial Librus API (login protocol, cookie sessions, typed readers)
- [data-service](apps/data-service/AGENTS.md): REST API on Cloudflare Workers using Hono with WorkerEntrypoint pattern (KV storage, device tokens)
- [web](apps/web/): PWA (React 19, Vite, Tailwind, TanStack Query)

## Rules

### General
- [General TypeScript & Cloudflare](.claude/rules/general.md): Type safety, error handling, naming, array access, bug fix workflow
- [Cloudflare Deployment](.claude/rules/cloudflare-deployment.md): Hostname separation, custom domains, SSL/TLS
- [Error Handling](.claude/rules/error-handling.md): LibrusError taxonomy + Result/AppError approach across packages
- [Deep Modules](.claude/rules/deep-modules.md): Module boundaries, where new files belong
- [Atomic Imports](.claude/rules/atomic-imports.md): combine import + usage in one edit

### librus-client
- [librus-client](packages/librus-client/AGENTS.md): login protocol, cookie jar, readers, HttpDeps injection

### data-service
- [Hono](.claude/rules/data-service/hono.md): Handler/service pattern, middleware chain, Result type
- [Cloudflare Workers](.claude/rules/data-service/cloudflare-workers.md): Worker patterns and bindings
- [Storage](.claude/rules/data-service/storage.md): KV patterns

## Agents

- [Design Doc Writer](.claude/agents/dd-w.md): Create design documents and technical specifications
- [Design Doc Implementer](.claude/agents/dd-i.md): Implement features from existing design documents
- [MVP Advisor](.claude/agents/mvp-e.md): Ensure speed-over-perfection principles

## Commands

- [Implement](.claude/commands/implement.md): Implement a design doc
- [Verify Design Docs](.claude/commands/verify-dd.md): Review design docs for implementation readiness
